checks.name: Existing review plan retained
checks.result: Eight ideas and the existing Konark note remained. Searching unhurried returned one saved idea; clearing restored all. Note search did not populate the URL.

checks.name: Note-free print view
checks.result: Unchecking Include my personal notes removed a synthetic private note from the printable DOM while retaining the original textarea value.

checks.name: Two-tab conflict
checks.result: Older tab disabled editing and retained its recoverable note; backup remained available. Reloading the newer tab retained its newer note. See conflict-browser.json.

checks.name: Photo-book feedback
checks.result: UI reported a book downloaded with five selected photographs and personal notes omitted. Actual downloaded bytes were not inspected.

checks.name: Checklist then note and day changes
checks.result: After ticking the opening/access reminder, edited the Konark note to AFTER CHECKLIST: notes stay editable. ଓଡ଼ିଶା and selected day 3. Reload preserved all three changes.

checks.name: Contribution invalid field
checks.result: Missing new-subject name focused the subject field; aria-describedby retained both length help and error status.

checks.name: Prepared issue invalidation
checks.result: A synthetic local draft produced a prepared issue link. Changing its type to Personal recollection removed the href and hid the link. No GitHub issue opened or submitted.

checks.name: Contribution draft download
checks.result: Local draft download was invoked. No external message or submission occurred.

limits: Native share sheet, clear-draft confirmation and real clipboard denial were code-reviewed, not all exercised end-to-end.
Photo cancellation is covered by automated abort tests; no claim of a timed live-browser cancellation test.
Only synthetic review data was edited on the new review origin.
Cross-tab protection is best effort; localStorage lacks an atomic cross-process transaction.
